Lights-Out Sweep.name: Lights-Out Sweep
Lights-Out Sweep.description: Moving from shadow to shadow, the user drops every unaware guard in a room, corridor or rooftop in turn before any of them can raise the alarm. Each target the user reaches falls unconscious; an armored or hardened target, or a seasoned pro or villain, is only knocked down, and the sweep stops the moment anyone sees the user. Stamina: heavy.
